plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Industrial Controls Technician Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 3, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7698/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 14; this seed = 8 + 6 = 14 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 8 / 6 headers. In-plan prereqs: IMMT 230 requires IMMT 120, 130, and 140 with grades of 'C' or better; IMMT 250 requires IMMT 230 with a grade of 'C' or better; IMMT 252 requires IMMT 250 with a grade of 'C' or better. Sequencing note (documented): in Semester 1, IMMT 120, 130, and 140 are taken during the 1st 8-week term and IMMT 230 during the 2nd 8-week term; in Semester 2, IMMT 250 during the 1st 8-week term and IMMT 252 during the 2nd 8-week term. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Industrial Controls Technician, Business & Industry Meta Majors. Distinct from the Electro-Mechanical Technician (map 7697) and Industrial Maintenance Technician (map 7699) certificates. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
